description:
tests/fixture_matrix.rs turns a run-time deferral into a pass: CheckOutcome::Deferred (line ~148) prints 'deferred: <reason>' and returns Ok(()), so the trial counts as passed while nothing ran. Header-declared defers are already ignored trials (with_ignored_flag, lines ~121-131 and ~156); run-time ones are not. Today five build-path trials pass this way: matrix::{00525_test_macro_assert, 00526_test_macro_fail, 00527_multiple_tests_mixed, sample_tests, sample_tests_module}::build ('kind: test fixtures don't yet run via build', run_fz2_build_path). They are visible in CI's test log.

Fold: every deferral, header or run-time, is one ignored trial carrying its reason; the pass count counts only trials that ran. Expected: matrix 2012 passed / 3 ignored becomes 2007 passed / 8 ignored (until the build path for kind: test exists).
Close when: no matrix trial returns Ok without running its check; the ignored list names each reason.
title: A deferred matrix trial reports as ignored, never as passed
